title: Deep learning-based multiparametric analysis of COVID-19 patients from a radiological perspective, a monocentric retrospective study
summary: Evaluation of clinical parameters and their impact on the length of hospital stay of COVID-19-infected patients. The clinical parameters studied include: Vital signs, BMI, medical history with previous diseases and symptoms, therapies.

interventions.name: Patients with corresponding chest CT imaging in which COVID-19-typical changes could be registered, taking into account the inclusion and exclusion criteria. Subsequently, the image datasets are evaluated radiologically, in particular COVID-19-associated lung parenchymal changes are precisely docume

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-CT chest examination COVID-19-associated changes
-SarsCov2-RT PCR examination
Exclusion criteria:
-Missing imaging (CT thorax)
-Incomplete examination due to premature termination
-Non evaluable examination due to limited image quality
